description: Accept a native tab drop into the active Space's Pins section, then verify return-home behavior, persistence, and teardown.
preconditions: Build and launch the exact Helium Dev.app from the selected lane with the isolated pins-drag-return-home profile
Keep one browser window open in one active Space with the vertical sidebar visible
Remove every existing Pin from the active Space before the first step
steps: Open https://example.com/ in an ordinary tab and use its context menu Pin command to create the first Pin
Open https://example.org/ in a second ordinary tab
Drag the full second tab row into the Pins section below the first Pin and release it on the visible drop indicator
Activate the second Pin, type https://www.iana.org/domains/reserved in the omnibox, and commit the navigation
Click the second Pin's favicon return control after its row changes to the Return to home title
Quit Helium Dev normally, relaunch the same isolated profile, and inspect the Pins section before opening another tab
Stop the isolated profile after the restored Pin order and home page have been checked
observables: The drag preview stays in the active Space's Pins section and shows the insertion point below the first Pin
After the drop, the ordinary tab row disappears and one durable second Pin appears below the first Pin
After the typed navigation, the second Pin remains in place and its row exposes the Return to home title and favicon control
The favicon return control navigates the existing Pin back to https://example.org/ without adding a duplicate Pin or ordinary tab
After normal quit and relaunch, both Pins return in the same order and the second Pin still uses https://example.org/ as its home
Stopping the profile leaves no matching Helium Dev process and no newly timestamped crash report
